notes: Head of the `רָחֲקוּ` unit moved from *stand* to *aloof*: the accepted note claimed *stand* carries the verb's lexeme of distancing, but rule 44's subtraction shows the reverse — *stand* alone names posture, *aloof* alone names distance. Everything else in the verse is unchanged.

ASV *spit in my face* recasts the Hebrew *they have not withheld spittle from my face*; the preposition, the noun and the suffix each keep a written English word, so the phrase is split rather than fused under rule 30, unlike the מִפָּנַי of JOB.30.11.
Marginal note *Or, at the sight of me* read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.
The packet header counts 18 targets while the token table lists t001–t016; the ids are what is partitioned, and all sixteen are covered exactly once.
